title: Unit Event — Walk on and on — Episode4 Let's Write A Song!

meta.Event Outline: In preparation for their next event, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Arata and the others set out to write different songs based on a single theme. Akito and An take on the duty of making the new track, but Toya wishes that he could contribute to lighten their load.

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Soma agreed to let me help him while I learned what I could about writing songs from him, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't let that get in the way of our performance. That means I'll need to focus more than usual.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to learn how to pull everyone forward like An and the others! I have to do everything I can to make up for not being able to work on our next song...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, it's a bit early, but let's call it a day for our joint practice.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Toya, Azusawa, you two seemed way more on it than usual!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to make up for not working on our new song since Akito and Shiraishi are.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was able to sing the way I did because you did a great job of leading, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You two were off the hook!
It was really inspiring and I had to do my best to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, let's keep this up and get in the best shape we can for our event!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Speaking of which, how are your tracks coming along?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Ours is going okay.
We decided to make something mellow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mellow? That seems rare of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember how you noticed that everyone singing during RAD WEEKEND sounded a little sad for some reason? I told Okazaki and his team about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because that feeling might hold the key to capturing “silence” in the right way.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Exactly. So, Aoyagi, thank you.
This song's proving to be our most difficult one, but I believe we'll be able to show just how passionate we all are by singing it with everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll be looking forward to that.
It'll be like witnesses EVER reach new heights.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Mine's about half finished.
I absolutely promise to have it ready in time for our event!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What kind of song are you writing, Mita?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Something that'll really get the crowd going.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I wanna make everyone go nuts and blow the roof off the place like what happened during RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I like that. You do a good job of interacting with the audience, Kotaro, so I'm sure your song will turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, just leave it to me! I'll take the reigns from EVER, send everyone sky high and toss it to you, Tono!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That should be fun, and I'll need to prepare myself for that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, Arata, how's yours coming along?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, I suppose. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have a general idea of what to do, but the drums and stuff still need a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we really want it to have a big impact overall. It needs to feel more electric, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I see. Luckily, we still have plenty of time until our event, so let's just keep chipping away at them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's take our time and make sure our event turns out to be a really good one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great job, you guys!
It's been a while, so wanna head over to MEIKO's place to chill?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
There's somewhere I need to be, so I should get going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I have a prior engagement...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I promised to keep it a secret, so I can't tell them that I'm going over to help Soma with his song...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You seem like you've been pretty busy lately. I hope you're not having trouble at home again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I'm doing okay.
But I appreciate the concern.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And there's no need to worry. It's just something I need to do right now, and it won't have an effect on the way I practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay...
Just don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't. Again, I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Akito's as sharp as ever.
Or am I just bad at hiding things...?)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Toya had to go?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he said everything's okay, but I feel like he's been hiding something from us lately...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Toya isn't very good at keeping secrets...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That explains why I haven't seen him in such a long time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, he was pretty incredible today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he was totally in the zone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Of course, Kohane, you were just as awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An.
Currently, I'm focused on performing as well as I can...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear, Kohane!
Which means we also need to do our best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I guess we don't have to worry about Toya. He's doing what he can to make sure he performs well and has been talking more about himself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, we told him that we'd take care of writing our new track. So, we gotta make it a good one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to hearing what it's like too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll need to come up with some ideas after I get home today, so let's get through our meeting fast.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, especially if we want it to sound better...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time!
Let's start heading home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'm gonna stay for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? You are? Then, I'll stay too and... Oh no! I have to help out again today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. We can talk later tonight.
Until then, An, good luck.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Kohane, are you not going home yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, Rin.
And MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm...
There's actually something that I'd like to ask you all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ask us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, so...
I want to learn how to make my own tracks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, if possible, can you tell me about any tips or tricks?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, An and Shinonome are writing one for our next event, and I feel really bad about not being able to help with that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I should be focusing on how I'm going to perform...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I keep wondering whether I could help out if I were able to write songs...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I did some research and gave it a try, but it was so hard...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... Hey, KAITO!
Know any good tips or tricks?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've never done any songwriting before, but as a DJ, I'm exposed to a wide variety of music...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I suppose people who write songs have somewhat meticulous personalities.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Meticulous?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because they likely place an incredible amount of value onto each note. Like...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO's cooking...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What? My cooking?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. You carefully choose what goes into each dish, right, MEIKO? I feel like songwriting works in a similar way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know how to use which ingredients because you understand how to make a dish delicious, yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, without that sort of knowledge, it'd be fairly difficult to cook anything good.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what if you listened to a bunch of really cute or cool songs?! That might tell give you some hints as to what to do, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some hints as to what to do...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give that a try...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful! I'd like to help with that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we give it a try right now?! As for what songs... Kohane, choose anything you like for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, anything I like? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. That should make it much easier for you to create something that captures who you are.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Great idea! Can I help too?
I wanna hear what you make, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
Thank you two very much...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck, all of you.
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I got this sudden urge to include a string melody and tried inputting it yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It's a bit of an acoustic, analog sound, but this part sounds pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
I didn't realize you could create such a delicate sound.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is incredible. Especially after he said that he wasn't very good at arranging sounds. The high and low sections are so well balanced. I can't complain. And I can't believe he did all this through just feel...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: To be fair, I got a little too excited about making this. I was worried that I threw in too much...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: If possible, I wanna try using this for the chorus. What do you think? Is it a bit much?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
For the chorus...?
Yes, this sort of sound would certainly leave a big impression on the listener.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You may end up getting a fairly muddy sound if you try to work this in. I recommend going with one or the other rather than both.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yeah, I figured...
Man, I thought I'd come up with something really good too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you did come up with something good. It'd be a shame to see it go to waste...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, but these things happen and there's not much we can do about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (By adjusting the volume at different frequencies... Or would it be better to pan the audio differently by moving the instruments around...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, even if it were to become more usable, it would stop being the sound that Soma'd envisioned...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hm? Aoyagi? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, um, I'm sorry...
I was just wondering if we could still use that phrase you'd come up with...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. You don't have to think about it so hard. If we can't use it, then we can't use it. I don't mind moving on from it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Then, okay...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Don't dwell on it too much.
Thanks to you, Aoyagi, I was able to achieve the sound I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Coming up with a good phrase wouldn't mean much if it fell apart after becoming too unbalanced. So, there's nothing for you to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Getting to watch Soma up close as he comes up with phrases has been a nice learning experience.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And he does so many things that I never would've thought to do on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I were able to write such a moving song...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Aoyagi? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, it just seemed like you had something on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: If it means making this song better, I'm all ears. I promised to also help you, Aoyagi, so feel free to say whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought that seeing you work would help me find a hint as to how I might be able to write a truly moving song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I haven't been able to come up with any answers...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You mentioned that a powerful sound would suit the “Action” part of your theme. And you saw the way I work on music, so...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this is going to help since your style probably differs from mine, Aoyagi, but this question just popped into my mind...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: What do you want to convey through your song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I want to convey...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah. What feelings do you want to convey? What kind of message do you want to send? If you don't know that, I don't think you'll be able to move someone else's heart.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: If the person writing the song can't answer that, then the listener won't understand what's going on. So, for your first step, you might want to try figuring that out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
It can be anything.
Joy, grief, anger, pleasure... They're all a songwriter's fuel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
For classical music, it's obvious that the composer put quite a lot of thought into each note in any given piece of sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I want to convey...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You can take your time. It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
This really is difficult.
